'''2011 Yavin 4 Regionals''' was a Players Committee regional, 7 May 2011, using the [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.2]] pool. The deck sheets below are transcribed from the Players Committee's scanned decklist PDF ([[:File:2011 Yavin 4 Regionals.pdf]]).

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.2]]
* '''Site:''' —
* '''Dates:''' 7 May 2011
* '''Winner:''' —
